Thanks Camila — I appreciate the quick turnaround and the filled template. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: We need the SOC 2 Type II covering hosted endpoints (that will satisfy our risk team for the pilot). If you have coverage for dedicated/private deployments, please note it but it's not required for pilot sign-off.
- HIPAA / BAA: Yes — we will need a signed BAA before any production pilot that processes PHI. For discovery it's okay to proceed with redacted examples, but procurement will expect the BAA in the contract phase.
- Retention: For now our standard is 30 days for short-term tokens and up to 7 years for audit logs; we'll confirm exact numbers but please indicate whether Redwood supports configurable retention windows.
- Encryption: Primary ask from our security team: data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). For PHI we'll prefer customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) if that's an option.

Also, could you point me to the security contact who can field a few technical questions? Priya will coordinate procurement/security on our side.

If you can provide a short packet with the SOC 2 (redacted if necessary) and a summary of encryption/retention capabilities, that would be great.

Hi Alex & Priya — Jordan here (Security/SE). Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) SOC 2: We can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood Hosted (covering our hosted inference API and control environment). The report is redacted for customer-identifying data but includes scope and test results. Attached: SOC2_Redwood_Hosted_TypeII_2026.pdf. If you need dedicated/private deployment coverage, we can provide a statement of coverage and discuss evidence collection.

4) Retention: We support configurable retention windows. Default for transient tokens is 30 days; audit/log retention can be configured up to multi-year retention depending on the deployment. Please confirm the precise windows you need and we'll annotate the SIG rows.

5) Next steps / artifacts: Attached a short controls summary (Security_Controls_Summary.pdf) and the SOC 2 Type II (redacted). I'll also fill the technical rows in the Redwood_SIG_v1.xlsx and mark where we can provide evidence.
